data.body: Landed: Gerrit 3483 merged as 37d83e8f308 on origin/main (submitted revision b505791b811: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved; 2026-11-20 21:21 PST). That patch set adds encoding=utf-8 at src/rebar/mcp_server.py:584, a site main gained (26da1361e2d) after the census; the guard flagged it on the server-rebased patch set e5028baca2d. AC1: on origin/main 37d83e8f308 the AST census reports 0 text-mode subprocess calls without encoding in src/rebar (it reported 85 on 717c50f8b33), and the Linux-gate test tests/unit/test_windows_text_encoding.py::test_no_src_call_decodes_child_output_with_the_locale_codec enforces it (module: 14 passed). AC2: make verify (verify-slot.sh, outside the command sandbox) on the change: 21538 passed, 1 failed = tests/unit/test_reclaim_resign.py::test_resign_makes_enforced_verify_pass_with_era_keys, then red on main and since fixed by 2825b4fe283; CI's Verified +1 on b505791b811 is the full suite passing with that fix. Follow-up owned here: .github/windows-sweep-deselect/locale-subprocess.args (14 tests) lands with breezy-hogged-mastiff's split; removing it needs a Windows sweep run, recorded on mastiff.
